text:
Hello gate crew,
After dinner changed little, but noise levels stayed in focus

Team, we need everyone sharp on pet handoffs today. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and that means we pause, check documents, and keep animals calm before anything else moves. If a traveler looks uncertain, slow the process down and hand them clear, simple guidance. Keep carriers level, keep voices low, and watch for stress signals the whole way through.

When you review a case, stay with the care plan and do not improvise. The welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs, and their notes should guide each step from intake to boarding. <<FACT F016>> If you are handling a restless pet, give the situation your full attention and alert the lead right away so the next move stays controlled. For any transfer through the hold, confirm the labels, the fit, and the secure closure before release.

One more urgent reminder: incident writeups must be clean, complete, and sent through the normal channel without delay. <<FACT F027>> <<FACT F102>> If anything looks off, document it plainly and pass it up at once. We cannot afford loose wording, missing checks, or quiet assumptions when an animal is already under strain. Keep standards tight, stay calm, and help each other finish the shift without shortcuts.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
